question:
**Select the most appropriate word that means the same as the group of words given.**

A change in the form or nature of something
solution: The correct answer is "**Metamorphosis**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of given words. • **Refraction: **it is the redirection of a wave as it passes from one medium to another. • **Camouflaging: **hide or disguise the presence of (a person, animal, or object) by means of camouflage. • **Hibernation: **an extended period of remaining inactive or indoors. • **Metamorphosis: **a change of the form or nature of a thing or person into a completely different one. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**metamorphosis**" means the same as the given group of words. • **Example**: *The **metamorphosis**__** **of the caterpillar into a butterfly is a beautiful process.* • Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of given words. • **Refraction: ** यह एक तरंग का पुनर्निर्देशन है क्योंकि यह एक माध्यम से दूसरे माध्यम में जाती है • **Camouflaging: ** छलावरण के माध्यम से (किसी व्यक्ति, जानवर या वस्तु) की उपस्थिति को छिपाना। • **Hibernation: ** निष्क्रिय या घर के अंदर रहने की विस्तारित अवधि। • **Metamorphosis: **कायापलट। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**metamorphosis**" means the same as the given group of words. 35:T81d, The erroneous segment is "**is not like**"
